text:
Max Hoffmann is a product manager who consistently bridges technical rigor and user-centric design in cybersecurity. As a collaborator during his graduate studies, I observed his ability to distill complex security protocols into actionable product strategies.  

His work on CyberShield’s threat detection platform showcased sharp product management skills. He led a cross-functional team to prioritize features that reduced false positives by 22% without compromising detection rates. This required balancing engineering constraints with customer feedback, a challenge he handled with clarity and persistence.  

Stakeholder management was equally compelling. When internal security teams resisted a new encryption protocol, Max facilitated workshops to align technical risks with business priorities. His approach minimized friction and accelerated deployment. He also prioritized UX research, conducting shadowing sessions to refine the interface for non-technical users, which improved adoption rates by 18%.  

Max’s curiosity and work ethic are standout traits. He regularly volunteers to mentor peers, sharing insights on balancing innovation with compliance. His calm under pressure and knack for turning ambiguity into focus make him a rare asset in high-stakes environments. A pleasure to work with.
